item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
Gifts Have Been Turned In!

Except for a couple people who have said they can get theirs in if only they have the extra time used for pinch-hitting, everyone who is going to turn in a present has turned in a present (or multiple, wowza, thanks!). Now, we all sit together and try to summon up good vibes with which to manifest pinch-hit gifts. Get ready to receive your gift (or gifts!) in three days time, on Christmas day itself! Happy waiting!

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
PMs Have Been Sent!

As of this post, every person who signed up has received their giftee in the form of a PM from either myself or Elogee FishTruck! They should be titled "Your Art Exchange Giftee!", but I have the sneaking suspicion I accidentally sent a couple untitled, heheh. Anyhow! From now until Dec. 22nd, it is time to create your gifts!

Note that gifts do not have to be turned in on Dec. 22nd, 21:00 PST, but instead may be turned in any time between now and then, to either myself or Elogee FishTruck. Dec. 22nd at 21:00 (9:00 PM) PST is simply the very last moment you can get a gift in before we turn over to pinch hitters.

If you didn't get a PM, or you got a PM with some information not filled in, or (Santa forbid) you got a PM meant for someone else, message myself or Elogee FishTruck immediately and we will get right on it! Otherwise…

Happy gifting, Secret Santas. See you all on the flipside~!

item.title: Nov. 28th, 21:00 PST
item.content:encoded:
Application is Over!

After this post, no one may add themselves to the 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange, hoowah! Looking over it, we seem to have a very good haul this year, so I'm really not worried. Nearly 100 participants. Isn't that crazy!? Now, Elogee FishTruck and I will put on our elf boots and fasten our reindeer antlers and get back to you all on November 30th with your giftees. Yeehaw!

(Are these exclamations working to make it exciting? It just feels right to include them somehow, heehee.)

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Voice work, a story, or a video.

What I am looking for: A link to a new tale on the wiki featuring Jeremiah Cimmerian in the Aces and Eights canon. You can use the information presented on the hub page to get an idea of what he's like in that canon, or ask me.

I don't care about the secret part of the whole art exchange thing, but if you're committed to that for some reason, you can go through an intermediary to ask me any questions.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
It's funny, I and Elogee got saddled with this because we don't find this to be a pain in the ass to manage. The entire process is very, very fun. Thank you for creating something so wonderful for the site to experience and enjoy each year. Seriously, this is my favorite thing that happens on this wiki, and it wouldn't exist without you.

Merry Santamas indeed. (And yeah, nearly a decade of this wonderfulness, isn't that crazy!?)

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I’d like to write you a tale or SCP based on your favourite article or anything else! I’m not much of a character author so I’d like to avoid writing the big names (bright, clef, etc.) if possible. Writing about science, horror, and short pieces are my specialty! If you want something weirder than normal stuff, I could try to make you a presentation or something on why your favourite article, most hated article, or anything really, is actually the best thing on the wiki.

What I Am Looking For: I would really like some art for any of my works or tale inspired by them or really anything else! If you really need some inspiration, I always enjoy reading articles that mix horror with humour!

Update: there’s like a week left but if you haven’t started it would also be cool to get something featuring the Department of Sciences in determining properties of an anomaly or establishing containment procedures. Or anything to help me characterize Dr. Dagon as a young researcher of the department of sciences or as department head

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
Last-minute entry here we go 😳

What I can give: Anything writing-related I can take a stab at. I'm willing to try SCPs, tales, even GoI formats if needed.

What I am looking for: Art or writing relating to the Limited Memory series would be great.

Alternatively, I'd appreciate prose that inspires wonder (think 'Wanderer's Library'). It doesn't have to be set in any specific canon or universe. Art or music set in the same general genre would be great if writing isn't your strong suit.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I can give: SCPs, tales or GOI formats. I've only done the Nobody and Chaos Insurgency format before, but they're all not that difficult to learn. I'm probably better at making something, that's already established.

What I am looking for: An article about my Explanation and Research Department short ExaRD (managing Explained SCPs) or its head, Director Weld. There is an Orientation about the Department, that will be posted soon. Until then you can find it in my sandbox under "Orientation-EX". To a lesser extant, ExaRD is also mentioned in SCP-2023-EX and Director Weld is featured in In Response to Nuclear Warheads. If you can't do that, feel free to make art of any of the things I posted.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
Okay, this is probably the first one of these I actually have time for, so I might as well put my name down.

What I can give: I can write SCPs or tales, although I'm better at the former. I lean towards concept-driven articles rather than sappy emotional stories. I'm also a cellist, for what that's worth.

What I am looking for: I will take art or an article featuring any of my solo SCPs (SCP-2801, SCP-3631, or SCP-4943), but I would especially like an article featuring my home-grown GOI Ravensgate Security Services. The short version is that they are a security firm that does pentesting, consulting, etc. for other GOIs, including the Foundation. I don't expect them to get very big - they are admittedly very niche - but I do want to flesh them out. For characters, you could include David Keyes's team, or you could write your own. The organizational structure isn't very well defined so far, so you have some freedom on that front. All I ask is that they remain a benevolent force, or at least a neutral one.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I can write anything that doesn't involve fancy coding but am best with Tales. Specifically Tales that are based mostly on plot and narrative, I'm not super good with dialogue. One thing to note is that all three of the Tales I had published have been pretty short, but I think I could write something longer if I needed to. I can make traditional art as well with black and white pencil and charcoal drawings but I'm still relatively new with that. If needed I would definitely be able to make some art, but would be more comfortable doing some writing if possible. Note that I am really bad at drawing faces.

What I Am Looking For: What I want is just some art. I don't really care what it is, I just would like art depicting something from one of the six Tales and SCPs I've written so far.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I never wrote directly on the site but I'm writing a novel so I am confident in my capacity to write tales. I'm better with fantasy based stuff and my first language is french, but I'll try my best to do what the person wants.

What I Am Looking For: Literally anything would make me happy, but I would love an SCP or a tale based around a "critic", maybe an anomalous entity that is a reviewer of timelines and worlds or something like that, to reference the "So… I finished" reviews and critiques of different series and canons I do on the SCP subreddit. (u/Retrom17 if you need a reference) And if that's too much to ask from me and art is better for you, my favorite SCPs are 1867, 3300 and 507.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!

What I Am Looking For: A skip or tale that takes place in a reality where the GOC has become such a huge threat that a bunch of GoIs banded together to create the Foundation. In this reality, the O5 Council is made up of representatives from different GoIs. :O

If that's too specific/weird/difficult, then I'll take a skip that somehow involves the concept of "cuteness aggression."

Thanks! <3

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!

  • A skip or tale expanding upon Agent Hopper, the Serpents' Hand aligned version of SCP-507 from Snippets of an Unveiled World.
  • A Parawatch article in the style of a Wiki page.
  • A skip or Parawatch tale about Westhead Media.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: An honest try at poetry, (paper) drawings, images for articles, and I don't mind attempting to write a tale if the original SCP isn't too complex or not from a big hub. This is my first exchange so please don't expect top-notch quality.

What I Am Looking For: If you are up for it, I'd love a tale, drawing or a simple poem about SCP-5147 (you can mention your own instances if you like to).

If the SCP above or the idea does not speak to you, I'd love to learn/see/read something about an animal or a plant that doesn't appear in Europe.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!

What I Am Looking For: I love art of my work and I'm always excited to receive more of it. That being said, I also really love poetry and archaic-style religious scripture. I'm a history buff, what can I say?

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I can give: Anything related to photos. Need an original or free to use image or photo of an obscure location or object for one of your articles? I can get you one. I can also offer my help for any article ideas you may need (although probably not with the actual writing of the article… I kinda suck in that)

What I'm looking for: My poor only SCP in this site, SCP-4562 had a nice tale written about it last year, which was sadly never posted. This year I'm looking for something similar : someone to expand on the article, either with a tale, a test log, or something similar.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: An SCP or tale based on a prompt or existing article, or a photoshopped image. (I'm reasonably skilled see image on 5733 for an example). Ideally the writing piece wouldn't be too heavily based in a particular canon.

What I am Looking For: Any artwork or a tale based on one of my existing skips. I would be particularly keen for any sort of help in improving my writing (For example: knowledge sharing of writing techniques, guidance on how to plan an article, a single 1-on-1 seminar etc) but aware this is something that may not be offered up!

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
Always looking forward to the Exchange. Thanks to both of you, DarkStuff and Elogee, for once again gracing us with this. You (and other, past hosts) bring joy to all the land each year.

What I Can Give: I'll write a Tale to your specifications. Whether it's set in your favourite setting/Canon, or involves your favourite Group of Interest, it doesn't matter; I'll do it. For ideas as to what I can offer — in past Art Exchange events I wrote these: 2018 | 2019.

+ A note (click me)
What I Can't Give
I cannot or will not write about any of the following: Characters which are first-generation Senior Staff Author Avatars (Drs. Clef, Kondraki, Gears, Bright — that sort of thing); the Bellerverse, Competitive Eschatology, lolFoundation, or Resurrection canons; or the Sarkicism GOI. No hard feelings — these are just areas in which I have little interest or understanding.
- A note

What I Am Looking For: An SCP, Tale, GOI Format, Artwork, OR Wanderers' Library Entry based on any of my pages. If you need something more specific, I would be especially delighted if any of these were depicted:

  • SCP-3309 and the Adamo Smalls & Heather Mason stories (I, II, III).
  • Team Bird/the Avian Division. Preferably set before the Migration scenario.
  • Moosphere, Incorporated. Doesn't need to be set in the Broken Masquerade.
  • Lampyra and The Watchers of The Lost Glade. Doesn't need to be set in the Broken Masquerade.
  • Something which builds on one of my obscure works! *cough Solidão, A Necromantic Prelude cough*

And preferably something you can post to the Wiki (optional, of course)!

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Writing. Format doesn't matter much. Much of what I write is about bureaucrats cutting ethical corners and people making bad decisions for bad reasons. No promise for a happy ending, but it could happen.

I can also do some software development as long it's not web-based and you don't mind dealing with a command line. Mostly linux-y stuff but anything I do there can be ported to Windows.

What I Am Looking For: Art or other media of my articles. If you're looking for characters, look no further than:

  • Madison Craggs, renegade scientist who sometimes confuses 'right and wrong' with 'right and left'. See also OCT entries.
  • A particular Japanese admiral who takes center stage in Setting Sun or his Foundation contact.
  • Jane Mossbury, a woman who has made it her life's work to keep everyone in the dark.
  • The endless bickering among the Ethics Committee, which would be amusing if not for the impossible stakes in SCP-3554

But any article is fair game.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I can give: Mostly tales and other similar formats, like this tale from the 2016 Art Exchange, or this tale from the 2017 exchange.

What I am looking for: If visual art is something you do, I'd love art of characters from Comedown Machine and Under Control, especially of Adam and Casey together. But any art of Casey, Adam, Vera, or Eustace would be lovely.

Another option for art would be characters from the ongoing Cool War 2 arc, written in the Canon Renaissance Contest by the Ruiz Duchamp Memorial Contest Team. Specifically Felicity Baudin (superplagiarist), Tanksy (the tankie banksy), and Casio (a 3d printer).

Alternately, I like tales, SCP articles, or other writing! Especially if they involve Laika's Sweetheart Space-Beacon, The Friendly Vacuum, or The Internet of Things That Are Wolves.

I will also accept art of the climactic battle from Clash of the Cosmic Comedians, but if you send me just art of Tim Allen alone I will come to your house and yell at you.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I can make a synth-based progressive electronic piece based on one of your works. My oeuvre tends to work with analog synth atmospheres, 80s sounds, and sci-fi ambiences, and my pieces can be quite complex - here's an example of one I made in the past. Declassifications - deep-diving, substantive, and personal ones - are also something I'd be happy to get back into making, although this is my second choice.

What I Am Looking For: Either (a) artwork based off anything I have written or (b) a piece of writing - tale or SCP - for the Shattered Thoughts (SCP-3426) protocanon that I've been working on for a while (if you do this, feel free to reach out to Yossipossi, Brewsterion 1017, or ValidClay for details on what it is).

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!

What I Am Looking For: Any sort of writing, artwork, audio creation, etc. regarding one of my works not set in the End of Death canon.

Thanks DarkStuff and Elogee for putting this together!

\o/

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
I still remember the first one of these. At the time, I thought it was destined to be one-off kind of deal, but here we are, almost ten (!!!) years later and it's still going strong.

Thank you, DarkStuff, for taking over the mantle. I know what a pain in the ass managing this can be, but it's something that means a lot to a lot of people, myself included. It's not a thing that's Djoric's or Photo's or mine or even yours, so much as it the community's, and I think that's really, really cool.

So, again, thank you for taking up the work for the third year running. Merry Santamas.
